name: Reva — heart red and ivory (comparison option M, softened)
supersedes: design/palette-supplied.json — the Ivory / Gold / Slate / Teal / Aqua / Sky swatches sampled from the user's image, kept for provenance.
method: Chosen from rendered comparisons of pink and red options; the primary was softened from #C0273A to #B84250 at the user's request. Every text/background pairing was checked with WCAG 2.x relative-luminance contrast.
treatment: Outlined: white cards with a hairline outline on a blush canvas; red reserved for actions, selected navigation, the heart glyph, and status chips; body copy neutral.

accent.role: Heart red: primary actions, selected tab, heart glyph, row icons

accentText.role: Deep red for chip labels and small red text

soft.role: Petal: status chips, notices, circular icon fills

hairline.role: Linen outline for cards, tiles, unselected filter chips; decorative only

notes: Pale rose #E8A0A6 from the comparison is not a token: the app has no pin or decorative glyph that needs it, and it fails as text (1.97:1).
Errors and destructive actions keep the system alert and role colours so brand red never doubles as an error signal.
A red cross symbol is a protected emblem and is not used; the health cue is the heart and the pulse line.
appearance: Light only in the current app (RevaApp forces .light). The dark block is reserved for a future dark appearance and is not wired to any token yet.
